title: Senior Business Analyst
jobDescription:
Senior Business Analyst

Product Development Job Roles Responsibilities

  1. Be the Operational Truth Source for the Platform. You will be accountable for validating that platform outputs make sense in the real world. This includes:
  • Reviewing payer contracts, amendments, and fee schedules
  • Interpreting real-world contract logic (lesser-of, modifiers, MCO products, effective dates)
  • Reading raw 835 remits and identifying: Reimbursement issues vs legitimate adjustments; Payer miss configuration vs provider error; Systemic vs one-off issues
  • Calling out false positives and explaining why something is not a true issue. If something looks technically correct but operationally wrong, you are expected to stop it.
  1. Own Synthetic Data Realism (Critical). The platform will initially rely on synthetic data for development and validation. You will:
  • Define what realistic synthetic data looks like: payer mix, CARC/RARC distributions, modifier usage patterns, underpayment frequency and dollar impact
  • Review synthetic data sets and flag unrealistic assumptions
  • Guide engineers and vendors on correcting synthetic data generation logic. This role protects the credibility of everything we build.
  1. Be Deeply Embedded in Testing Validation. You will be hands-on in:
  • Reviewing detection outputs and classifying true vs false positives
  • Validating confidence scores against operational reality
  • Helping define suggested next step classifications (appeal, rebill, review, do not pursue)
  • Testing against real customer data during pilot phases. Your feedback will directly shape detection logic, confidence thresholds, and future AI agent behavior. You are effectively the human-in-the-loop backbone of the system.
  1. Act as the RCM Counterweight in Vendor Engagements. You will actively participate in vendor evaluations, technical reviews, and edge-case discussions. You will:
  • Ask uncomfortable but necessary questions
  • Spot hand-wavy answers around contracts or EDI
  • Distinguish between can build, has built, and is guessing
  • This role is critical to holding vendors accountable and ensuring delivery meets operational standards.
  1. Help Carry the Long-Term Platform Vision Forward. While the MVP starts with underpayments, the platform is designed to evolve toward:
  • Broader reimbursement correctness (denials, old AR, charge capture)
  • Recommendation intelligence and outcome monitoring
  • Selective automation with AI agents
  • Contract renegotiation insights. You will help ensure core data models are reusable, intelligence is generalized, and we t hard-code short term assumptions that block long-term evolution.

Candidate Requirements

Experience Domain Expertise

  • 6-10+ years in health care RCM revenue integrity, payer contracts, payment analysis, denials, or A/R
  • Experience working with ambiguous or conflicting data
  • Deep knowledge of payer contracts and fee schedules percent of Medicare, lesser-of, MCO products, modifier rules, effective dates
  • Deep knowledge of the RCM data ecosystem claims, remittances, fee schedules, industry benchmarks, regulatory references, and how they connect
  • Deep expertise in at least one RCM process area (appeals, denials, A/R follow-up, payment posting) you ll help design how AI agents execute these work flows

Judgment Mindset

  • Strong judgment in gray areas where contracts, data, and payer behavior don t line up
  • Willingness to challenge assumptions including those from engineers and vendors
  • Comfortable saying this would never happen in production
  • Builder mentality: you like shaping systems, not just running reports
  • Technical Comfort (Not a Data Scientist)

Technical Comfort (Not a Data Scientist)

  • SQL proficiency ability to query data, validate outputs, build test cases
  • Advanced Excel pivot tables, VLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, large data set manipulation
  • Comfortable working with raw data (CSV, JSON, EDI extracts)
  • Able to explain domain logic clearly to engineers you t need to code, but you must understand how logic translates into systems

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Background in underpayment recovery, contract audits, or payer disputes
  • Familiarity with Medicare fee schedules and locality adjustments (GPCI)

jobDescription:
About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise, we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate we re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession, collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

If you re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

Role

We are looking for a Principal AI Security Specialist to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to Ron Burkett. As enterprises race to adopt generative AI, Zscaler is seeking an experienced Principal AI Security Specialist to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI innovation and robust enterprise security. In this highly strategic, field-facing role, you will combine the elite consultative strengths of a Solutions Engineer with deep expertise in LLMs, RAG architectures, and data protection to serve as a trusted advisor to Fortune 500 executives. As our premier technical authority, you will help customers confidently unlock the power of AI without compromising their data or infrastructure.

What you ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Architect the AI Technical Strategy: Partner with enterprise account teams to own and execute the technical sales strategy, driving complex, high-value AI security opportunities from discovery to close

  • Deliver Compelling, High-Impact Demos & POVs: Configure and present tailored, outcome-driven demonstrations of Zscaler s AI security platform that resonate with both deep-tech practitioners and C-level executives

  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert: Act as the field authority on modern AI patterns (such as RAG, agents, and prompt workflows), advising clients on how to prevent sensitive data exposure and unsanctioned AI usage

  • Scale the Field Motion: Collaborate with Product and Engineering to inject real-world customer feedback into the product roadmap, while building reusable demo assets and enablement playbooks to upscale our global sales force

  • Enable Those Around You: Develop reusable demos, technical assets, competitive positioning, and enablement content to help scale Zscaler s AI field motion while sharing best practices and training with enterprise account teams

  • You thrive in ambiguity, remaining comfortable building the path as you walk it and viewing dynamic environments as the raw material to create something meaningful.

  • You are a high-trust collaborator who is ambitious for the team, embracing a challenge culture by giving and receiving candor with clarity and respect.

  • You are customer-obsessed, building deep empathy for both internal and external customers to anchor decisions in solving real-world problems.

  • You are driven by innovation, possessing a deep curiosity for how things work and an energy for solving complex technical challenges to accelerate secure transformation.

What We re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Deep Fluency in AI/GenAI: Strong foundational knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), MCP (Model Context Protocol) orchestration patterns, and the inherent security risks associated with them

  • 10+ Years of Solutions Engineering Mastery: A proven track record in a customer-facing technical role (Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Technical Advisory) navigating complex, enterprise-level sales cycles

  • Enterprise Security Foundations: Solid grasp of cybersecurity principles, including Zero Trust architecture, data loss prevention (DLP), cloud-native security platforms, and API integrations

  • Elite Executive Communication: Exceptional presentation and storytelling skills, with a demonstrated ability to seamlessly translate complex AI architectures into tangible business value and security outcomes

  • Collaborate and Co-elevate: Successfully work cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other go-to-market teams in a hyper-growth, rapidly evolving market

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Hands-on AI Prototyping: Interacting with LLM APIs, scripting, creating agentic automation routines, and building lightweight AI applications

  • Advanced AI Risk Expertise: Direct experience helping enterprises deploy production AI technologies while navigating data leakage, model governance, compliance frameworks, and shadow AI usage

  • Scale & Enablement Focus: A history of creating high-impact field assets, technical workshops, and competitive positioning content that helps broader go-to-market teams win

jobDescription:
Location: Bengaluru, Visakhapatnam, Delhi, Mohali, Nashik

Role Overview

We are looking for an exceptionally sharp Process Consultant someone who operates at the intersection of business understanding, process design, and technology feasibility.

The person we hire will be the intellectual engine of our transformation engagements: the consultant who walks into a clients business, rapidly builds the first-principles understanding of how that business actually works and makes money, diagnoses where value is leaking, and designs future-state processes that are not just elegant on paper but technically feasible, automation-ready, and commercially sound.

You will be trusted to challenge how clients operate today, to tell them what should be automated and just as importantly what should not, and to translate ambiguous business problems into structured, buildable solutions. You will work primarily within Finance and Accounting environments, applying Business Process Management (BPM), Intelligent Automation, AI, and Digital Transformation methodologies.

  • Who You Are
    • Intellectually rigorous. You have a strong academic record and demonstrable analytical horsepower. You think in structures, frameworks, and first principles not templates. You can hold a complex, multi-entity, multi-system business in your head and reason about it.

    • A genuine business consultant, not just a process mapper. You understand the clients business model, revenue drivers, cost structure, and regulatory context before you touch a single process map. Your recommendations start from business needs and work backward to solutions.

    • Fluent in technical feasibility. You know what RPA, AI, IDP, workflow platforms, and process mining can and cannot do. You can assess whether a proposed solution is buildable, scalable, and maintainable and you can defend that assessment to both a CFO and a solution architect.

    • Comfortable with ambiguity. You can enter an engagement with no playbook, structure the problem yourself, and produce clarity where none existed.

Requirements
Provide subject matter expertise across Finance and Accounting operations, including:
  • Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR)
  • General Ledger (GL), Financial Close Reconciliation
  • Cash Application, Billing Invoicing

  • Procurement and Shared Service Center Operations

Business Understanding Process Discovery
  • Rapidly develop a deep understanding of each clients business model, operating context, industry dynamics, and strategic priorities.
  • Lead discovery workshops with stakeholders across functions and geographies.
  • Analyze current-state (AS-IS) processes, systems, controls, handoffs, and pain points.
  • Conduct structured process assessments to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, compliance risks, and automation opportunities.
  • Evaluate process maturity and readiness for automation, standardization, and transformation.
Process Design Transformation
  • Design optimized future-state (TO-BE) processes aligned with best practices, business objectives, and automation principles.
  • Challenge existing operating models; recommend improvements that increase efficiency, scalability, control, and customer experience.
  • Develop transformation roadmaps and prioritized improvement initiatives grounded in business value.
  • Apply Lean, Six Sigma, BPM, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Define business rules, exception-handling frameworks, governance structures, and operational controls.
Technical Feasibility Solution Shaping
  • Assess the technical feasibility of proposed solutions across RPA, AI, workflow automation, OCR/IDP, and process mining before commitments are made to clients.
  • Identify the right automation candidates and, critically, flag processes that are poor automation candidates and require redesign or human judgment.
  • Work closely with Solution Architects and Automation Developers to translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable solutions.
  • Lead automation opportunity assessments and ROI/business-case development.
  • Ensure redesigned processes are automation-ready before development begins.
  • Participate in solution design workshops and client presentations as the voice of both business logic and technical realism.
Experience

Required

  • Proven track record redesigning finance and accounting processes end to end.
  • Experience leading client-facing process discovery and consulting engagements.
  • Demonstrated experience assessing solution feasibility and shaping automation scope.

Preferred

Technical Skills
  • Strong command of BPM methodologies and advanced process mapping (Visio, Lucidchart, Signavio, Bizagi, ARIS).
  • Working knowledge of process mining tools (Celonis, UiPath Process Mining).
  • Solid understanding of RPA platforms (UiPath, Power Automate), AI-enabled automation, Intelligent Document Processing, and workflow automation platforms sufficient to judge feasibility, effort, and risk.
  • Experience with major ERPs is a benefit: SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, Workday Financials.
Certifications (Preferred)

  • CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional)

title: BU FP&A - Financial Analyst - CP&O
jobDescription:
This Business Unit FPA Analyst position is located in Bengaluru, India, and reports to the Team Lead, BU FPA Capability under the Controlling Practices and Operations (Finance COE) organization. The role supports Hitachi Energys global Business Units, Hubs (Regions), Global Product Groups (GPGs), Countries, and Operating Units, serving as a finance partner to business and finance stakeholders to drive financial performance, forecasting accuracy, reporting excellence, and operational insights.
What we see in you: A strong foundation in financial and cost accounting, supported by solid FPA and analytical skills. You are an effective communicator, passionate about learning and continuous improvement, and eager to apply insights and drive execution in a highly complex global manufacturing environment.
Key Responsibilities
  • Perform analysis of business performance versus Budget, Flash, Forecast, Latest Estimate, prior Quarter, and Prior Year.
  • Consolidate, challenge, and validate forecasts received from project, business, country, and factory stakeholders, ensuring consistency of assumptions, forecasts, and financial outlooks across the designated BU, Hub, or product group.
  • Support monthly forecasting, budgeting, and planning processes.
  • Monitor and analyze Order Backlog, Revenue, Gross Margin, EBIT, SGA, Headcount, Productivity, Working Capital, Cash Flow, and Capex.
  • Prepare monthly management reporting packs, KPI dashboards, executive presentations, and variance analysis.
  • Support month-end close activities. These include validating the accuracy, integrity, and completeness of financial actual KPIs in reporting tools Vs system reports, identifying, escalating, and resolving gaps, consolidating estimates from factories and countries at the Hub or product group level, preparing preliminary updates to stakeholders in a time-bound manner, including preparing and posting manual journal entries and intercompany postings.
  • Perform Balance sheet analysis proactively identify PL and Balance Sheet accounting impacts, contract assets and liabilities, inventory, and net working capital movements between different periods with the reasons for deviation and advise controllers for necessary action.
  • Analyze Cash Flow, Inventory, and Net Working Capital performance and provide insights
  • Support product, project, customer, factory, and business profitability analysis.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams including Operations, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, commercial and wider finance teams.
  • Perform trend analysis, scenario modeling, and ad hoc financial analysis.
  • Support audits, controls, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Analyze overhead /labor under/over absorption, material standard cost variances, and identify root causes and corrective actions.
Knowledge and Skills
  • Strong financial accounting and revenue recognition methods (Point in time, Percentage of Completion, Time-based, etc.)
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with proactive, self-motivated, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Good Microsoft Excel, financial modeling, and PowerPoint skills
  • Ability to use and leverage AI good AI literacy is a strong plus.
  • Effective communication presentation skills.
  • Good understanding of SAP S/4HANA is highly desired, including FICO, CO-PA, SD, PP, MM; highly desired.
  • Initiative-taking with a strong commitment to quality, adhering to strict deadlines
Experience:
2 to 4 yearsexperience in Financial Planning and Analysis, with a preferable manufacturing background. prior experience in controlling COE setup preferable
Education:
Bachelors degree in accounting with CMA/ CA / MBA Finance

title: Supply Chain Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Job Summary
The purpose of this role is practical application of data science in supply chain planning and inventory management to improve underlaying processes and deliver financial value.
To succeed in this role, you must have multidisciplinary skill set - proven experience in project management and SC planning, knowledge of planning systems (SAP APO/IBP, OM Partners or similar), SAP architecture (underlying tables, transactions) and strong technical and analytical skills.
In this creative role you will have unique opportunity to collaborate with various stakeholders in the global organization working on various improvement initiatives, development of analytical tools, optimization models or supply chain simulations and you need to feel comfortable in each stage of this process (design, develop and deploy) to thrive and succeed.
You are self-starter with hands-on approach and continues improvement mindset working on your own initiative under moderate supervision. You know how to source and use data together with statistical methods and technology to improve processes. It is important you have theoretical knowledge but more important you understand how to use it in practice to add value.
Your nearest assignments will focus on portfolio segmentation, product life cycle management, development of replenishment strategies and inventory optimization within distribution network. All contributing to development of planning tool supporting decision making process for planning teams.
Qualifications
  • Degree in Supply Chain Management or APICS CPIM certification and 5-7+ years experience in Global Supply Chain and Inventory Management essential (multi-site, multi-region),
  • Degree or certification in Data Science desirable,
  • Formal Project Management and problem-solving training desirable, e.g., Six Sigma, Lean.
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Demonstrated ability to select and work with appropriate analytical tools and software (Excel, PBI, relevant libraries in R and Python or SQL) and build ETL pipelines,
  • Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development and automation tools, such as Codex, to accelerate data analysis, code development, documentation, troubleshooting, and creation of analytical tools while applying appropriate validation and governance,
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, data quality, business relevance, bias, and operational feasibility before applying them to supply chain planning, inventory optimization, or decision-support processes,
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze large data sets and visualize findings,
  • Demonstrated ability to wrangle, cleanse and model data from various sources (SAP, .csv, .xlsx, .txt, .parquet, .rds, data lake etc.),
  • Proficient in Excel and Power BI (Power Query/M, DAX, relational database model, data visualization); Power BI Data Analyst Associate certification is a plus,
  • Knowledge of SQL and R/Python highly desirable,
  • Experience working with data warehouse/data lake desirable (experience with Snowflake a plus),
  • Knowledge of Statistics and Machine Learning or strong willingness to quickly develop in this area.
Demonstrated ability to analyze large data sets and to prioritise actions for maximum impact.
Ability to develop and deploy short-term tools and reporting capabilities (with quantified accuracy and precision) essential.
Solid written and verbal communication skills, experience in a matrix environment desirable.
Environmental Working Conditions and Physical Effort
Typically works in an office environment with adequate lighting and ventilation and a normal range of temperature and noise level.
Work assignments are diversified. Examples of past precedent are used to resolve work problems.
Most aspects of work are timebound and fit into a standard reporting cycle based on the monthly financial reporting calendar. There is an ongoing requirement to work to deadlines and to manage competing priorities.
Minimal physical effort is required. Work is mostly sedentary but does require walking, standing, bending, reaching, lifting or carrying objects that typically weigh less than 10 lbs.

title: SeniorFPGA Developer
jobDescription:

Working for a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway.   • Deep, hands-on expertise with FPGA transceivers, hard IP, and PLLs including timing closure, equalization, and link debug at multi-Gbps rates required (not incidental exposure).
  • Demonstrated experience closing timing and debugging link-layer issues on high-speed Ethernet (10M to 1.6T) and IP protocol stacks in production designs.
  • Proven expertise with optical interfaces and modules (SFPs, QSFPs) in shipped products.
  • Deep working knowledge of VLANs, MPLS, VPLS, and Voice/Video over IP (VoIP, IPTV).
  • Extensive experience with AMD or Altera FPGA devices and their full implementation toolchains, including advanced timing closure and floorplanning techniques.
  • Proven experience with formal verification and/or UVM-based verification methodologies, not limited to directed testbenches.
  • Demonstrated track record of taking FPGA designs from architecture through volume production, including systems-level tradeoffs across the HW/FW boundary.
  • Version control experience using Git or similar tools.
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills, including the ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture decisions with stakeholders across the world.
  • Exceptional analytical and organizational skills, with an uncompromising commitment to accuracy and technical rigor in a fast-paced product environment.

  • General purpose microprocessor and DSP systems, PCIe, high-speed digital board design, PLL design, and analog signal conditioning experience.
  • Simulation experience using Siemens Questa, Aldec Riviera, or similar tools.
  • Contribution to or deep familiarity with open verification methodologies (e.g., cocotb, UVM community contributions).
  • Utilization of generative AI tools to assist in concept and implementation of FPGA designs.

Job Title : Senior Product Manager

About Locus

Battle-tested in 350+ deployments across 30+ countries, Locus is an agentic Transportation Management System for all-mile, all-channel, trusted by enterprises like Unilever, Nestl , and Siam Makro.

The platform unifies orders, capacity, and carrier networks into one living plan, aligning planning, execution, and settlement so promises become proof. AI co-pilots with guardrails surface risk early and recommend the next best move to protect SLAs and reduce empty miles.

In 2025, Locus joined the Ingka Group (IKEA Retail) family, marking a major milestone in our journey. Backed by the scale and strength of IKEA, we continue to operate independently while accelerating our mission to make global supply chains faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

Our Journey and Impact

Since 2015, Locus has been on a mission to make logistics decision-making intelligent, sustainable, and real-world ready. Our platform has powered billions of deliveries across 30 + countries for global enterprises, driving measurable impact in cost savings, carbon reduction, and SLA performance. With the strength of the IKEA ecosystem behind us, we re scaling that impact even further.

Our Global Footprint

Headquartered in Bangalore, with teams across the U.S., U.K., UAE, and Southeast Asia, Locus brings together 170 + engineers, designers, and problem-solvers united by a single goal: to reinvent how the world moves goods.

Traits We Value

We look for people who are:

  • Global in mindset : curious about diverse markets and ideas.

  • Unrelenting in drive : energized by complex challenges.

  • Intelligent in approach : analytical, creative, and thoughtful.

  • Dynamic in execution : adaptive and decisive in fast-moving contexts.

  • Exact in craft : detail-oriented and committed to excellence.

About the role

Locus is rebuilding last-mile delivery as a multi-tenant SaaS platform. The DiSCO Mobile App is the driver-facing surface - used by drivers, 2-person crews, and hub-ops staff across enterprise tenants (IKEA, Giant Tiger, and the long tail of Locus customers).

The Senior PM will own one or more product modules end-to-end - Hub Depot Operations, Execution at Customer Stop, Returns Reverse Logistics, Multi-Trip Shifts, or Workforce Auth - from scoping with domain PMs, through workflow design with UX, to release readiness with the engineering pod and customer-onboarding teams.

The role partners with the Principal PM on overall app vision and runs its modules independently.


What youll do

  • Own a slice of the mobile app: scope it, write the spec, drive design partnership, shepherd it through engineering, land it in tenant rollouts.

  • Author mobile workflow specs (Delivery / Pickup / Hub Depot / Returns) and the matching epic + story tickets in Jira.

  • Coordinate with domain PMs (Execution, Hub Ops, Workforce, Order Management) to translate entity specs and design decisions into driver-facing scenarios.

  • Partner with UX on gap closure and with the mobile engineering pod on sequencing and delivery.

  • Own one or more enterprise tenant rollouts - translating customer requirements into product changes vs. tenant config, and holding the line on what is product-grade vs. one-off.

  • Uphold platform defaults: client-agnostic architecture, point-of-use permissions, plain-language UX, no over-engineered enterprise theatre.

What were looking for

  • 6+ years in product management, including 3+ years on enterprise SaaS or platform products. Mobile app PM experience is a strong plus.

  • Shipped in domain-heavy, multi-team environments - comfortable reading entity specs, sequence diagrams, and engineering RFCs, not just user stories.

  • Spec author. Can write a 3,000-word workflow doc that engineering, design, and customer success can all build from.

jobDescription:
>

Technical Solutions Lead, Nature-Based Carbon

Location: Gurgaon, India

Type: Full-Time

Experience: 4-10 years

Tags: Nature Based Solutions Regenerative Agriculture Agroforestry Arr Afforestation Soil Carbon Agronomy Mrv Remote Sensing Carbon Methodology Due Diligence Technical Writing Additionality Permanence Smallholder Farming Contract Farming Agri Business Sustainable Sourcing Climate Tech Voluntary Carbon Market

About Varaha

Varaha is the largest carbon removal developer in Asia, working with more than 200,000 smallholder farmers. Trusted by brands like Google and Microsoft, we combine an exceptional team with deeply impactful work. Through regenerative agriculture, afforestation, and biochar, our projects remove carbon while simultaneously restoring soils, protecting biodiversity, and improving livelihoods far beyond our project boundaries. We are a profitable, rapidly growing company backed by premier global private equity and top-tier venture capital. Our roots are in India, and our impact is global.

The Opportunity

Varaha runs the largest smallholder soil carbon project in the world and has closed the largest regenerative agriculture deals in the market. Behind that sits a measurement stack built on multiple bio-geo-chemical models, remote sensing, and machine learning, calibrated against physical soil samples from the field by a world-class science team. Buyers, auditors, and funders all want the same thing from it: a clear, sourced account of what we measured and why it holds.

You are the commercial teams technical authority on regenerative agriculture and afforestation, and the person who turns several hundred thousand hectares of fieldwork into documents a Chief Sustainability Officer can act on. Regenerative agriculture comes first. Afforestation and reforestation follow.

We are deliberately open on background. Agronomists from agri-conglomerates, people who have run contract farming or sustainable sourcing programmes at scale, agri-input and agri-tech technical leads, remote sensing specialists, and programme leads who have delivered smallholder work across large geographies all fit. What matters is that you have stood in a field, know what the data from it can and cannot support, and write clearly.

Reporting To: CCO

Key Responsibilities

  • Answer buyer and auditor diligence. Sort what you can answer now from what needs expert input, then produce the response with sources, assumptions, and the limits of the claim stated.

  • Sit in on sales calls. You explain the measurement, the project, and the impact directly to the client. The project team stays on the projects.

  • Run our side of ratings and verification. Prepare submissions, handle analyst and auditor questions, and push back with evidence where a finding is wrong.

  • Build the answer library so the same question is never answered from scratch twice and our language stays consistent across proposals, contracts, and project documents.

  • Create what is missing. Method summaries, appendices, diagrams, data summaries, and operating procedures, wherever a gap is holding up a deal.

  • Turn data into claims. Read agronomy datasets and remote sensing outputs and convert them into short statements we can defend in front of a buyer.

  • Cover the impact side. Farmer and community outcomes weigh as heavily with buyers as the carbon itself. You build the evidence base on incomes, livelihoods, and co-benefits across 200,000+ smallholders, work with what the field data supports when it is limited, and state where it is thin.

  • Guide the commercial team on presenting technical content accurately, and train them to handle the straightforward questions themselves.

Qualifications

  • 4-10 years working on agriculture, agroforestry, or land use, ideally involving smallholder farmers in Asia or Africa.

  • Technical writing that has survived outside scrutiny. Project documents, monitoring reports, diligence responses, or funding proposals. Please send samples.

  • A working grasp of the fundamentals that decide whether a carbon project is credible: baselines, additionality, permanence, leakage, and buffer pools. If you know these from an adjacent field, say so and we will look at it.

  • Comfort with soil carbon or biomass measurement, sampling design, and the monitoring that sits around it.

  • Ability to work with agronomy data and remote sensing outputs directly.

  • Skilled at using AI tools to digest dense material and produce strong first drafts fast.

  • Written English at a standard that holds in front of international buyers.

  • Commercial judgement. Benefits, costs, and risks presented without inflation.

  • Structured habits: clean intake, targeted questions to experts, careful citation, and documents you can find again.

Preferred

  • Experience with any carbon standard, including direct auditor interaction. Not required.

  • Grant or concessional funding proposals with results you can point to.

  • Writing operating procedures for field protocols and quality control.

  • Confident enough on a call to lead a session with a US or European buyer alone.

Why This Role Matters

Nature-based carbon has a credibility problem across the industry, and much of it comes down to how the work is explained. Varahas measurement is among the strongest in the sector. Making that legible to buyers and funders moves capital toward 200,000 smallholder land stewards who are already doing the work.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity through ESOPs.

  • The first seat in this function. You define how it works.

  • Direct exposure to the largest corporate carbon buyers in the world.

  • Support for learning and professional development.

  • A culture of undogmatic, unbureaucratic creativity and collaboration.

Outscale Partners (formerly AMH Services) is a Gurgaon, India-based global capability center (GCC) and strategic business solutions partner for the Argenbright Group, founded in 2022. Role Summary

Reporting to the Senior AI Consultant, the AI Engineer will design, build, deploy, and operate AI systems across Unifi Service s enterprise platforms.

The role spans the entire AI lifecycle use-case identification, model and system design, production deployment, monitoring, optimization, and continuous improvement.



Core Responsibilities

Build and integrate AI-driven capabilities into enterprise applications and workflows using leading LLM platforms.

Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures to enable AI systems to securely leverage internal knowledge and data sources.

Develop and orchestrate AI agents capable of executing multi-step, decision-based business processes.

Own production AI systems end-to-end, including deployment, versioning, monitoring, scaling, and cost optimization.

Define, implement, and maintain evaluation metrics for AI quality, reliability, latency, and cost efficiency.

Collaborate closely with Leadership, Product and Engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and deliver high-impact AI solutions.

Must-Have (Non-Negotiable) Skills Experience

7 to 8 years of overall software engineering experience, with 3 to 4 years of hands-on work on production AI / LLM systems.

Strong proficiency in Python, with experience writing production-quality, testable, and maintainable code.

Proven experience designing and implementing RAG pipelines, including document ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, and response generation.

Hands-on experience with vector databases (e.g., Qdrant, FAISS, ChromaDb, or similar).

Practical experience using LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Autogen, Haystack, or Semantic Kernel.

Prior experience building AI solutions in SaaS or enterprise-scale software environments.

Experience integrating with major LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or Google Gemini.

Solid understanding of prompt engineering, context engineering (context window management), and output control techniques.

Experience deploying AI systems to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) using Docker and Kubernetes.

Working knowledge of LLMOps MLOps practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and rollback strategies.

Experience in implementing guardrails in AI Solutions along with Observability.



Preferred / Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Exposure to multimodal AI systems, model fine-tuning, or reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF).

Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Understanding of AI cost optimization, latency tuning, and performance benchmarking in production.

Experience with domains such as eCommerce, Retail, HR, Finance, Legal, Compliance, etc



Language Documentation Expectations

All production AI code must be clearly documented, version-controlled, and supported by appropriate tests.

AI pipelines, prompts, and agent workflows must include design documentation and usage guidelines.

Each production AI system must have defined ownership, monitoring dashboards, and operational runbooks.

Clear documentation of model limitations, assumptions, and fallback behaviours is mandatory.




What We Offer

High-visibility role with direct access to senior leadership and decision-makers.

Opportunity to design and own enterprise-scale AI systems with real business impact.

Hybrid work arrangement, balancing flexibility with collaboration.

title: Computational Biology Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Role Summary
The AIN-based Computational Biology Data Scientist will design, implement, and advance advanced analytical and AI-driven frameworks to enable translational and reverse-translational insights from clinical trial data across Amgens global development portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of computational biology, advanced statistics, and modern machine learning, with a strong emphasis on predictive and prognostic biomarker modeling, multi-omic data integration, and next-generation AI-enabled analytical platforms.
The successful candidate will contribute intellectually and technically to Amgens precision medicine strategy by developing rigorous, scalable, and scientifically interpretable models that link molecular, cellular, and clinical phenotypes to disease stratification, efficacy, safety, and adverse event outcomes. This role requires demonstrated depthnot familiarityin applied modeling, multi-omic analytics, and AI systems, with evidence of impact through peer-reviewed publications, production-grade codebases, or verifiable industry experience.
Key Responsibilities
Advanced Modeling Translational Analytics
  • Design and implement predictive and prognostic biomarker models using clinical trial and biomarker data, including response, resistance, disease stratification, and adverse event endpoints.
  • Develop and apply multi-omic integration frameworks (e.g., factor models, MOFA-style latent variable approaches, matrix factorization, graph-based methods) to jointly analyze genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, epigenomics, imaging, and clinical covariates.
  • Apply advanced statistical methodologies relevant to clinical development, including longitudinal and mixed-effects models, survival analysis, missing data and imputation strategies, confounder adjustment, and model interpretability.
  • Contribute to study-level and cross-program analyses that inform mechanism of action, patient selection strategies, and development decisions.
Machine Learning, AI Emerging Capabilities
  • Build and evaluate machine learning, deep learning and causal inference models applied to biological and clinical data, with a clear understanding of model assumptions, limitations, and validation in regulated environments.
  • Develop or meaningfully contribute to AI-enabled analytical systems, including:
    • Foundation and large language modelbased approaches (e.g., GPT-class models) for scientific workflows
    • Generative models for representation learning, hypothesis generation, or simulation
    • Agentic AI systems (assistive, conversational, automated, predictive, or sentinel) to support analysis, decision-making, or platform capabilities
  • Partner with platform and engineering teams to ensure analytical methods are reproducible, scalable, and production-ready.
Scientific Rigor, Collaboration Communication
  • Translate biological and clinical questions into well-defined analytical strategies and clearly articulate modeling choices, assumptions, and uncertainties.
  • Collaborate closely with biomarker scientists, clinicians, biostatisticians, and data engineers across global teams and time zones.
  • Communicate complex analytical results and their implications effectively through technical documentation, presentations, and cross-functional forums.
  • Operate with scientific independence while proactively seeking alignment and clarification in a highly matrixed, global development environment.
Basic Qualifications
  • Doctorate degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related quantitative discipline with 12 years of relevant experience
    OR
  • Masters degree in a quantitative discipline with 5 years of relevant experience
  • 6+ years of experience in an industry setting
Preferred Qualifications
Candidates should provide verifiable evidence for most of the following:
Quantitative Computational Depth
  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience developing statistical or machine learning models for complex, multi-modal biomedical or clinical datasets, evidenced by:
    • Peer-reviewed publications in reputable journals, and/or
    • Public or internal GitHub repositories with substantive analytical or modeling contributions, and/or
    • Clearly documented industry experience supporting clinical or translational programs.
  • Proven expertise in Python and R for scientific computing and modeling, including the development of reusable, well-documented analytical code.
  • Experience with modern ML/DL libraries and frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, tidymodels), with an understanding of when such methods are appropriate given clinical context.
Translational Clinical Relevance
  • Demonstrated understanding of drug development and clinical trial data, including biomarker strategies, endpoint definitions, and translational study design.
  • Experience working with real-world clinical or biomarker data, including data QC, preprocessing, feature engineering, integration, modeling, and interpretation.
  • Familiarity with common clinical biomarker modalities and data types (e.g., NGS, transcriptomics, proteomics, imaging, immunoassays).
AI, Innovation Platform Mindset
  • Direct experience applying or extending generative AI, foundation models, or agentic systems for scientific, analytical, or decision-support use cases.
  • Ability to critically evaluate new methods and technologies and assess their suitability for regulated, high-impact biomedical applications.
Professional Global Operating Skills
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills, with the ability to explain complex quantitative work to diverse audiences.
  • Experience working with global teams and stakeholders across time zones; willingness to operate flexibly to support global programs.
  • Demonstrated intellectual humility, adaptability, curiosity, and the ability to pivot analytical approaches as program needs evolve.
  • Strong sense of ownership, scientific judgment, and accountability in complex, interdisciplinary projects.
What Will Distinguish Top Candidates
  • Clear evidence of end-to-end ownership of analytical work that influenced scientific or development decisions.
  • Depth in framework-building, not just model application.
  • A demonstrated ability to balance methodological sophistication with biological and clinical relevance.
  • Prior experience in large, global biotech or pharmaceutical organizations is strongly preferred.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

What you do at AMD changes everything. At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences-from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you'll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world's most important challenges-striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead System Validation for BIOS, Firmware and Driver validation activities across our embedded product portfolio. This role will provide hands-on technical leadership, drive validation coverage, strengthen test planning and execution discipline, and ensure timely visibility to critical issues, risks and customer-impacting defects. The leader will work closely with development, silicon IP enablement, silicon validation, platform and customer-facing teams to ensure validation readiness, reduce test escapes and improve engineering effectiveness through scale and AI-driven initiatives.

The Person

  • A strong technical validation leader with deep understanding of system-level validation across BIOS, firmware, drivers and platform software stacks.
  • Demonstrates ownership in defining validation coverage, test strategy, execution governance and defect triage for complex silicon and platform programs.
  • Builds trusted networks across client and server ecosystems, development teams, silicon IP enablement teams and validation organizations to improve end-to-end product readiness.
  • Balances technical depth with people leadership, helping the team grow in capability, execution maturity, collaboration and customer orientation.
  • Brings a continuous improvement mindset with the ability to drive scale, automation, traceability and AI-enabled productivity across validation workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership for system validation activities covering BIOS, firmware and driver validation across assigned embedded programs.
  • Define and drive the right validation coverage by partnering with architecture, development, silicon IP enablement, silicon validation, platform and customer enablement teams.
  • Own test management discipline including validation planning, test readiness, execution tracking, completion governance and timely reporting of progress, gaps and risks.
  • Drive first-level triage for critical issues by ensuring structured debug data collection, clear ownership alignment, prioritization and timely handoff to the appropriate development teams.
  • Establish strong collaboration forums with BIOS, firmware, driver, silicon IP, silicon validation and platform teams to close coverage gaps and improve defect discovery earlier in the lifecycle.
  • Build and maintain technical connects in the client and server spaces from which the group leverages devices, ecosystems, validation methodologies and learnings.
  • Reduce validation escapes through improved test strategy, coverage analysis, defect trend reviews, regression rigor and disciplined exit criteria.
  • Support customer escalations and critical field issue triage as required, ensuring responsiveness, technical clarity and coordinated execution across engineering owners.
  • Lead team development by coaching engineers and leads, improving technical depth, strengthening ownership behaviors and building succession for key validation areas.
  • Drive scale initiatives across validation execution, including automation, reusable test assets, consistent dashboards, traceability from requirements to tests, and execution efficiency improvements.
  • Champion AI initiatives that improve test planning, coverage mapping, traceability, execution tracking, defect analytics, reporting quality and validation productivity.
  • Partner with program management and engineering leadership to provide accurate status, risk visibility, decision points and recovery plans for validation milestones.

Preferred Experience

  • 20+ years of industry experience with 8+ years of exposure with people management roles
  • Experience leading system validation, post-silicon validation, platform validation, BIOS validation, firmware validation or driver validation teams for complex silicon or platform products.
  • Strong understanding of validation lifecycle, test plan development, coverage definition, test execution governance, defect management, regression strategy and exit criteria.
  • Hands-on familiarity with BIOS, UEFI, firmware, drivers, platform initialization, silicon bring-up, debug flows and system-level validation environments.
  • Experience collaborating with silicon IP enablement, silicon validation, firmware, BIOS, driver, platform, architecture and customer-facing teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead issue triage, drive technical discussions, identify ownership, escalate risks and close critical defects with urgency.
  • Experience with customer escalations, field issue debug, escape analysis and corrective action planning.
  • Working knowledge of test management tools, defect tracking systems, coverage dashboards, automation frameworks and traceability practices.
  • Experience applying automation, data analytics or AI-assisted methods to improve validation planning, execution tracking, reporting or defect insights.
  • Prior people management experience with demonstrated ability to hire, coach, develop and retain high-performing validation engineers and leads.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present validation status, risks, technical issues and execution plans to engineering and business leadership.

Academic Credentials

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical discipline.
  • Equivalent industry experience in system validation, firmware, BIOS, driver, silicon validation or platform engineering will be considered.
